description: Header file defining the QuicCryptoServerStream class, which manages QUIC server-side cryptographic stream operations, including handshake, encryption, and token validation.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerStream
classes.description: Manages server-side QUIC cryptographic stream, including handshake, encryption, token validation, and configuration updates.

methods.name: CancelOutstandingCallbacks
methods.description: Cancels any pending callbacks.

methods.name: GetBase64SHA256ClientChannelID
methods.description: Retrieves the client's channel ID in Base64 SHA256 format.

methods.name: SendServerConfigUpdate
methods.description: Sends an update of the server configuration.

methods.name: DisableResumption
methods.description: Disables session resumption.

methods.name: IsZeroRtt
methods.description: Checks if the connection is using 0-RTT.

methods.name: IsResumption
methods.description: Checks if the session is a resumption.

methods.name: ResumptionAttempted
methods.description: Indicates if resumption was attempted.

methods.name: EarlyDataAttempted
methods.description: Indicates if early data was attempted.

methods.name: NumServerConfigUpdateMessagesSent
methods.description: Returns the number of server config update messages sent.

methods.name: PreviousCachedNetworkParams
methods.description: Gets previous cached network parameters.

methods.name: SetPreviousCachedNetworkParams
methods.description: Sets previous cached network parameters.

methods.name: OnPacketDecrypted
methods.description: Handles a decrypted packet at a given encryption level.

methods.name: OnHandshakeDoneReceived
methods.description: Handles the event when handshake completion is received.

methods.name: OnNewTokenReceived
methods.description: Handles reception of a new token.

methods.name: GetAddressToken
methods.description: Generates an address token based on network parameters.

methods.name: ValidateAddressToken
methods.description: Validates a given address token.

methods.name: ShouldSendExpectCTHeader
methods.description: Determines if Expect-CT header should be sent.

methods.name: DidCertMatchSni
methods.description: Checks if the certificate matches the SNI.

methods.name: ProofSourceDetails
methods.description: Retrieves proof source details.

methods.name: EarlyDataReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for early data status.

methods.name: encryption_established
methods.description: Checks if encryption is established.

methods.name: one_rtt_keys_available
methods.description: Checks if 1-RTT keys are available.

methods.name: crypto_negotiated_params
methods.description: Accesses negotiated cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: GetHandshakeState
methods.description: Returns the current handshake state.

methods.name: SetServerApplicationStateForResumption
methods.description: Sets application state for session resumption.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Gets buffer size limit for a given encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Advances cryptographic keys and creates a decrypter for 1-RTT.

methods.name: CreateCurrentOneRttEncrypter
methods.description: Creates an encrypter for current 1-RTT.

methods.name: GetSsl
methods.description: Returns the SSL object.

methods.name: IsCryptoFrameExpectedForEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Checks if a crypto frame is expected at a given encryption level.

methods.name: GetEncryptionLevelToSendCryptoDataOfSpace
methods.description: Gets the encryption level for sending crypto data in a specific packet space.

methods.name: OnHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Processes a handshake message.
